paragraphs.en: Do you usually find yourself falling short on time in {completing} {assigned} tasks? I used to be in the same {boat} .When I was just {eighteen} , I felt I had {infinite} time.But time just flies; chasing {balloons} as a child who was in his favorite {brown} {sweater} just feels like {yesterday} .No matter how hard I tried, tasks just kept {piling} up towards the end every day.I'm almost {buried} with tasks like answering the {telephone} , paying the {bills} , and trying to balance work and family, and it became {extremely} difficult to stay {productive} .In {spite} of trying all kinds of free and paid to-do {apps} , nothing helped.
paragraphs.cn: 在 <u> 完成指定 </u> 任务时，你是否经常发现自己的时间不够用？我以前也有同样的 <u> 困境 </u> 。我刚满 <u> 18 </u> 岁的时候，觉得自己有 <u> 无限的 </u> 时间。但时光飞逝，小时候穿着自己最喜欢的 <u> 棕色毛衣 </u> 追逐 <u> 气球 </u> 的日子仿佛就在 <u> 昨天 </u> 。无论我多么努力，每天临近结束的时候，任务还是 <u> 堆 </u> 积如山。我几乎被接 <u> 电话 </u> 、付 <u> 账单 </u> 、试图平衡工作和家庭等任务 <u> 淹没 </u> 了， <u> 很 </u> 难保持 <u> 高效 </u> 。 <u> 尽管 </u> 我尝试了各种免费和付费的待办事项 <u> 应用程序 </u> ，但都无济于事。

paragraphs.en: That didn't change until I {discovered} the time {management} {technique} called Time Blocking.Since then, I have been able to {transform} my {daily} {schedule} for the better with the help of Time Blocking.So what is it {exactly} ?
paragraphs.cn: 直到我 <u> 发现 </u> 了名为"时间块规划法"的时间 <u> 管理技巧 </u> ，这种情况才有所改变。从那以后，在时间块规划法的帮助下，我得以让我的 <u> 每日日程安排 </u> 朝着更好的方向 <u> 转变 </u> 。那么，时间块规划法 <u> 到底 </u> 是什么？

paragraphs.en: It is a simple time management technique where you schedule your day such that it is {divided} into time {blocks} that are {dedicated} to specific tasks or {groups} of tasks.Let's further explain the {concept} in another way. {Suppose} {Mr.} Johnson has a {dozen} or so tasks that he wants to finish, but his schedule is as messy as a {plate} of mixed {noodles} .He opens his to-do app of {choice} and {neatly} lists everything that he plans to do, and then {plots} some important meetings and {reminders} in his {calendar} app.He needs to be very specific about the time and what he's planning to do: from nine to {eleven} in the morning on {Tuesday} , he focuses only on important projects; he takes a break in the {cafeteria} by 1:00 p.m., enjoying a {sandwich} and perhaps a cup of {maple} tea.Time for exercise, {recreation} , or family isn't {neglected} : he sets aside an hour on {Wednesday} evening to play {volleyball} and helps his {nephew} and {niece} with their {kindergarten} homework on {Thursday} .
paragraphs.cn: 它是一种简单的时间管理技巧，运用这种技巧，你可以将自己的一天时间进行规划，将其 <u> 划分 </u> 成若干个时间 <u> 块 </u> ，每个时间块都 <u> 专门用于 </u> 特定任务或任务 <u> 组 </u> 。我们再来用另一种方式进一步解释这个 <u> 概念 </u> 。 <u> 假设 </u> 约翰逊 <u> 先生 </u> 有大约 <u> 十几 </u> 项想完成的任务，而他的日程安排就像一 <u> 盘 </u> 杂烩 <u> 面 </u> 一样混乱。他打开自己 <u> 选择 </u> 的待办事项应用程序， <u> 整齐地 </u> 列出自己计划要做的所有事情，然后在 <u> 日历 </u> 应用程序中 <u> 标记 </u> 一些重要的会议和 <u> 提醒 </u> 。他需要非常具体地规划时间和计划要做的事：比如 <u> 周二 </u> 上午九点到 <u> 十一 </u> 点，他只专注于重要的项目；下午一点前，他在 <u> 自助餐 </u> <u> 厅 </u> 休息，吃一个 <u> 三明治 </u> ，或许再喝一杯 <u> 枫 </u> 糖茶。锻炼、 <u> 娱乐 </u> 或与家人相处的时间也没有被 <u> 忽视 </u> ：他在 <u> 周三 </u> 晚上留出了一个小时去打 <u> 排球 </u> ， <u> 周四 </u> 帮助 <u> 侄子 </u> 和 <u> 侄女 </u> 完成 <u> 幼儿园 </u> 作业。

paragraphs.en: Life is like a {skateboard} ride—fast, {thrilling} , and sometimes unpredictable.Thus, the {benefits} of Time Blocking are {substantial} .It not only makes your to-do list more {manageable} , but also it gives you more {control} over your day and helps you {prioritize} your tasks.It also improves your {focus} and helps get {rid} of procrastination ( (拖延症) ), as it {allows} you to focus on one {project} at a time.This will help you {cherish} every moment, allowing you a quiet evening to enjoy warm tea from your nice {teapot} .
paragraphs.cn: 生活就像在 <u> 滑板 </u> 上驰骋——快速、 <u> 刺激 </u> ，有时又不可预测。因此，时间块规划法的 <u> 好处 </u> 是 <u> 巨大的 </u> 。它不仅让你的待办事项清单更 <u> 易于管理 </u> ，还能让你更好地 <u> 管控 </u> 自己的一天，并帮助你 <u> 确定 </u> 任务的 <u> 优先级 </u> 。它还能提高你的 <u> 专注力 </u> ，帮助你 <u> 摆脱 </u> 拖延症，因为它 <u> 让 </u> 你一次只专注于一个 <u> 项目 </u> 。这将帮助你 <u> 珍惜 </u> 每一刻，让你拥有一个宁静的夜晚，享用精致 <u> 茶壶 </u> 里的热茶。 5NoOncib/NjiX02BpMIzP+Fxyt/ox+WDCb+dhfH7KaYaJ4u5RsVmLondVmcHiLum9J1BQErGzJvzqa5GEIz4ZA==
